description: Hezbollah strikes on Israel on 2 March, followed by Israeli airstrikes including on Beirut; no single agreed end date (US-Iran-Lebanon committee to conclude the war announced 30 June)
Drone strike on the Beirut seafront killed at least 8 and wounded 31 (Stories has a Ramlet El Bayda branch)
Ground operations in southern Lebanon begin
Wide wave of Israeli strikes across Lebanon
US-mediated Israel-Lebanon cessation of hostilities; Israeli airstrikes continued
US-facilitated agreement; Hezbollah rejected it on 4 June
Truce announced by the US president, effective 4 p.m. local time; sources disagree on this date
